approvedFreeze.bytesNeverChangeOnApprovalStatement: The bytes of the approved freeze do NOT change on approval. This record is additive and immutable; the freeze file is not edited, not re-hashed and not re-statused by it. Its raw SHA-256 and byte length after this approval are identical to the ones approved above.
approvedFreeze.statusFieldInsideTheFreezeRemainsStateme: The status field inside the freeze remains PROPOSED_PENDING_OWNER_FREEZE_APPROVAL BY DESIGN. Approval is recorded here, in a separate file, precisely so that the approved bytes stay byte-identical to the bytes that were reviewed. A status flipped in place would change the very hash the owner approved.
approvedFreeze.approvalIsFreezeOnlyStatement: This approval is FREEZE ONLY. It fixes the immutable configuration of the final V6 N=5 DEVELOPMENT study and nothing else. It creates no study root, no control root, no slot output directory and no execution-authorisation candidate, and it consumes no authorisation.

lineages.note: This build is the approved V6 SEMANTIC prompt running on the accepted F0Z EXECUTION/RELIABILITY harness. The two lineages are separate and are both named here. It is NOT a new semantic V7.

semanticSource.delta: v6 = v5 + R1 + R2 + R3, three exact whole-region REPLACE operations. Reversing them reproduces v5 byte for byte.

reliability.timeoutContinuationRule: A CONFIRMED non-terminal Tier-1 TIMEOUT makes ONLY ITS OWN logical batch observed INVALID_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT, counts against MAX_NON_TERMINAL_TIMEOUTS_PER_REPLICATE, continues only when every C1 precondition is satisfied, and is NEVER rerun. At the ceiling the replicate STOPS.
reliability.noDuplicateLogicalEvaluationAfterContinu: A continued replicate resumes at the NEXT frozen logical evaluation. A timed-out evaluation is closed durably and is never re-attempted, so no logical evaluation is ever executed twice.

studyDesign.studyQuestion: Does V6 reproducibly satisfy the frozen DEV gates?

outputRoots.note: NAMES ONLY. Neither root, nor any of the five slot subdirectories, exists, and none is created by this record. Verified absent at recording time.

batching.finalInputSha256IsRecomputedForV6: finalInputSha256 folds in the prompt version, so a V6 batch is a DIFFERENT call identity from the byte-identical V5 batch. It is computed by the production computeFinalInputSha256 from the inherited assemblyInputSha256, never copied from a V5 plan.

requestCeilings.derivationSource: Each logical batch's own deriveCallCeiling(documentCount) from the attempt-4 plan: one original request per logical evaluation, at most one ADR-0011 repair request per document, and each provider request attemptable 1 + maxTransientRetries times.

conditions: all 5/5 V6 replicates are COMPLETE under RELIABILITY_SEMANTICS_V2_TIMEOUT_CONTINUATION
each of the 5/5 replicates passes every one of the six frozen DEV gates

priorRuleReconciliation.existingRule: The attempt-1..4 configuration freezes each carry scoring.acceptanceRule: 'No final acceptance decision may be issued while <attempt> coverage is incomplete ... or while any stop condition is unresolved. HOLDOUT stays forbidden until a DEV candidate passes every frozen gate.'
priorRuleReconciliation.reasoning: The existing rule is a SINGLE-RUN criterion: complete coverage, no unresolved stop condition, every frozen gate passed. This rule preserves all three and additionally requires them on ALL FIVE replicates. It is strictly stronger, so no stricter existing rule was displaced and no previously-frozen rule conflicts with it.

finalDevDecisionRuleRestated: DEV_READY_FOR_HOLDOUT is issuable only if ALL FIVE of five V6 replicates are COMPLETE under RELIABILITY_SEMANTICS_V2_TIMEOUT_CONTINUATION AND each of those 5/5 replicates passes every one of the six frozen DEV gates. Any partial replicate, or any complete replicate failing any frozen gate, yields DEV_NOT_READY_FOR_HOLDOUT. No 4/5 fallback, no averaging away a failing replicate, no threshold tuning after outcomes, no replacement of a failed replicate, and an unmeasured gate is never a passed gate.

noAdaptiveScoring.rule: A favourable or unfavourable intermediate result never changes the remaining slot count, the slot order or the analysis contract. All five authorised replicates must first reach terminal records; only then may the deterministic v2 scorer run, under a separate owner scoring authorisation.

inclusionRules.principle: FAIL CLOSED. A replicate that reaches semantic/provider execution is part of the study and is NEVER silently replaced.

classA.meaning: No semantic replicate exists for the slot.
classA.action: Preserve evidence and PAUSE that slot. Not included as a replicate; not silently skipped either - it remains visible as a paused slot.

classB.meaning: The candidate is spent, but no semantic replicate exists.
classB.action: Do NOT auto-replace. Pause and require a separate owner-reviewed recovery authorisation for the SAME frozen slot. A pre-inference auth/lock/control-plane defect that consumed no semantic candidate may be eligible for a DISCLOSED reissue only under this explicit, predeclared rule.

classC.meaning: Any provider request or semantic execution occurred for the slot.
classC.action: That slot is IRREVOCABLY part of the study, whether it completes or ends in a genuine terminal failure. Never replaced, never discarded, never rerun.
